scope: Vercel Sandbox / OCI / VCR execution-surface discrimination only

observations.evidence: Existing exact-identity Vercel build-internal Sandbox execution in the linked Dr.-Unterweger project ran the EntityOS deterministic suite with 195 tests passed plus 12 subtests and stopped the sandbox cleanly.
observations.limitation: This proves the Vercel Sandbox execution mechanism, not current ClayVerse behavior.

observations.evidence: The linked Vercel build host could clone Dr.-Unterweger but an exact git fetch of the second private research repository failed with 'could not read Username for https://github.com'. No Sandbox was started by that failed source-staging attempt.
observations.implication: Ambient credentials from one linked private repository must not be assumed to authorize another private repository.

observations.evidence: A Vercel Sandbox on the default Amazon Linux 2023 environment could not install podman or buildah from the available dnf repositories; the observed run failed closed and the sandbox was stopped.
observations.implication: Repeating dnf-based podman/buildah provisioning is low-information duplication. This does not prove that Vercel custom images or VCR are unusable.

observations.evidence: Vercel build orchestration reported CLI 58.1.0, but spawnSync('vercel') inside npm run vercel-build returned ENOENT. /usr/bin/buildah was present on the build host, while docker and podman were absent.
observations.policy_note: Build-host buildah is not accepted as ClayVerse build evidence because current execution law requires isolated Sandbox validation.

observations.evidence: The follow-up pinned vercel@58.1.0 locally and was limited to read-only `vcr --help` / `vcr build --help` capability inspection, with no registry writes. GitHub's Vercel status for the exact commit failed with target_url containing upgradeToPro=build-rate-limit, so no new deployment/build evidence exists for this preflight.
observations.implication: Do not infer VCR builder semantics from documentation alone; exact executable observation remains pending.

observations.evidence: The connected Vercel team currently exposes one project, `dr-unterweger`, linked to the private Dr.-Unterweger repository. No directly linked clay-global-research-entity project is exposed through the current connector surface.
observations.implication: A dedicated research-repo Vercel source binding would eliminate the stale cross-repo fixture transport if/when such project creation/linking is available through an authorized surface.

external_primary_direction.mechanism: Vercel Container Registry plus Sandbox custom image
notes: Vercel documents `vercel vcr build docker . <repository>:<tag> --push` for OCI image build/push.
Vercel documents `Sandbox.create({ image: ... })` for starting a Sandbox from an existing container image.
VCR authentication is documented as short-lived project-scoped OIDC for docker/podman/buildah.
The exact current CLI/build-engine behavior remains empirically unresolved because the read-only preflight is provider-rate-limited.

rejected_shortcuts: Do not use Vercel READY as test evidence.
Do not use build-host buildah as accepted ClayVerse build evidence.
Do not assume credentials from the linked Dr.-Unterweger repository authorize the private research repository.
Do not promote the stale SHA-bound ClayVerse snapshot staged in Dr.-Unterweger to current canonical evidence.
Do not add a reusable remote arbitrary-command endpoint or expose credentials to work around source transport.
current_blocker: Exact-current-head ClayVerse OCI build/runtime evidence cannot yet be obtained through the observed path: default Vercel Sandbox cannot provision podman/buildah from its repos, the linked Vercel project cannot ambient-fetch the second private research repo, and the read-only VCR CLI discriminator is currently blocked by Vercel build-rate limiting.
next_executable_step: When the Vercel build-rate gate permits another preview, run only the already-prepared read-only pinned VCR CLI preflight. If it confirms an admitted VCR builder path, use a directly bound current research source (prefer a dedicated Vercel project linked to clay-global-research-entity over copied fixtures), produce an exact-digest OCI image, then start that exact image in Vercel Sandbox and run current-head tests plus boot/restart/auth/persistence/effect gates. If the CLI proves it requires a local engine unavailable inside Sandbox, retain OCI validation as BLOCKED rather than weakening sandbox-only policy.
